title: Serpent's Offering
description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a giant purple flower with a detailed blue eye at its center, dripping yellow liquid from above. Below, a yellow-skinned woman with red flowers in her hair sits entwined with a large blue and black snake, holding a small green teddy bear, surrounded by groups of identical white-dressed figures, melting candles, and vibrant dripping landscapes.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting with a massive purple flower containing a large detailed blue eye at the top center, yellow liquid dripping downwards. In the foreground a yellow-skinned woman with red floral crown sits cross-legged wrapped by a giant blue and black patterned serpent, holding a small green teddy bear. Groups of identical women in white dresses with purple floral patterns stand on melting green platforms on both sides. Tall melting candles with faces and flowers line the scene. Vibrant dripping colorful landscape with black cracked borders.
